items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: I was on the road with Lloyd Price and I was playing.

ctx.x: Yeah. What was that place? It was across the street.

No, it's on the same side of the street, but just in the next block. Yeah. Red Rail, man. And that's how I started playing bass, you know. But I never had a job playing bass like on the road. You see like I was on the road with Lloyd Price and I was playing. The only time I played bass was local. And lately I've been over in Europe. I played. I went to Finland, Helsinki, Franklin. I played there. And I played in Bangkok, Thailand. You know. And I went to Monte Carlo, but I didn't play bass there. I played my alto…
So you played with Montrell at Texas Lounge. What year was this?
